description: Make an EMAIL TEMPLATE in Mailchimp from a creative: image (any reference upload_mailchimp_image takes; it goes into the File Manager first) plus copy YOU write in the brand's voice (read get_brand for voice and colours): headline, body (paragraphs split by a blank line), ctaText + ctaUrl for the button, accent (#RRGGBB button colour). It is laid out as a 600px email with the unsubscribe link and mailing address Mailchimp requires. Or pass html for the user's own markup (that footer is added if it has no *|UNSUB|*). Saves the template only, nothing is sent; returns the templateId for create_mailchimp_campaign. Free. Needs Mailchimp connected (Connectors > Mailchimp, or connect_connector with an API key).

html.description: your own full HTML instead of the layout

image.description: a Library id, or a Hermoso or upload_file URL

name: create_mailchimp_template
title: Create a Mailchimp email template
